info.name: SMemories - customisation editor (E09)
info.description: Design-image uploads (E09 stage 2, T-152, D-43): `POST /api/media/create` with `purpose=design` and `GET /api/media/get-list?purpose=design` (folder design-images); a run makes about 9 uploads (limit 60 per 10 minutes per user). Book designs (E09 stage 1, T-141, D-41): `GET /api/book-design/get`, `POST /api/book-design/update`, `POST /api/book-design/reset`, the `design` of `GET /api/book-data/get` and the reset when a book's template changes. `{status,data}` envelope, `ERROR_*` codes. Uses the two verified accounts of notes.postman_collection.json (A owns the books, B is the other user; book-data/get needs a verified email): run that collection's Setup once (or this one's) and then `make verify-newman-users`. Run from the repository root: `newman run postman/customisation-editor.postman_collection.json`. Start the API with SMEM_ENV=dev and the `make up` stack. Each folder creates and deletes its own yearbook, so the collection can run twice in a row; a run makes about 40 design writes (limit 60 per 10 minutes per user, `make reset-limits` clears it), so wait or reset between two runs. Layout history (T-163): folder `book-layout history (T-163)` covers `version-list`, `version-get` and `restore` and the snapshots that `save` and `reset` store; it makes about 12 rate-limited calls (the `save` limits apply, burst 20 per 10 seconds) in its Full flow.

book-layout (T-153)
item.description: Free layout document: save with optimistic concurrency, validation (assets, media ownership, limits), owner-only access, template change, print data. Saves are limited to 20 per 10 seconds per user: if two runs follow each other within 10 seconds the later one can get 429; `make reset-limits` clears it. Needs the Setup folder first and the two test accounts email-verified (`make verify-newman-users`).
